contradictions.finding: vtables.json meta.functions=58756; canonical triage/xref closure=58757; live Ghidra manager count=59245.
contradictions.resolution: Use 58757 as the frozen canonical denominator; preserve 58756 and 59245 as scope/snapshot drift.

contradictions.finding: The candidate scan reports 3081 tables but only 20 labels; vtable confidence HIGH is table-structure confidence, not class identity confidence.
contradictions.resolution: Report candidate versus identity confidence separately.

contradictions.finding: 0x01485550 is App::cCellModeStrategy in vtables/dossier/current source, while decomp-gap/triage projections include it in an Editors::cEditor family due shared pointer runs.
contradictions.resolution: Preserve both; do not infer a single class family from projection overlap.

contradictions.finding: The cCellModeStrategy dossier lists AddRef as a member, but the raw table contains unnamed/non-function entries and repeated shared targets rather than a recovered AddRef symbol.
contradictions.resolution: Treat AddRef as dossier/SDK evidence and keep raw slot targets unknown.

contradictions.finding: Sporepedia decomp-gap projections associate 0x01490be8 with cSPAssetDataOTDB, while vtables.json labels it Terrain and includes Terrain::cTerrainSphere::GetSimDataRTT.
contradictions.resolution: Preserve the contradiction; do not promote family or hierarchy.

contradictions.finding: Some vtable members have zero direct caller counts while their vtable association is present.
contradictions.resolution: Do not call them unreachable; virtual dispatch is not represented as a direct-call edge.

contradictions.finding: Current source lifecycle mapping is described as one-to-one for ten named Cell-mode methods, while the original table has 27 slots and only ten named methods in the supplied SDK association.
contradictions.resolution: Treat the current IGameMode as a partial clean-room contract, not a complete original ABI.

contradictions.finding: Field offsets are observed or SDK-supported, but meanings such as lock/moving/camera semantics remain inferred or runtime-unvalidated.
contradictions.resolution: Keep field offsets and semantic meanings in separate evidence fields.

contradictions.finding: The global campaign has stale/variant category populations: 39716 triage-v6 UNKNOWN, 48296 in an older v5/v6 debt reference, and 35771 genuinely_unknown debt ownership.
contradictions.resolution: Use the cited artifact population for each claim; do not combine denominators.

contradictions.finding: No function-level runtime validation exists; cell-stage probes are negative in the recorded campaign.
contradictions.resolution: No record is marked observed or verified at function-contract level.

methodology.constructor_destructor_policy: Constructors and destructors are header declarations. Release, Dispose, Delete, Close, and similar lifecycle methods are never silently treated as destructors.
methodology.family_unit: SDK/header class or interface identity, with anonymous binary vtable nodes retained separately
identity_order: factory-like signatures and static call topology
methodology.reconciliation_policy: Contradictory labels, duplicate addresses, absorbed SDK addresses, static functions in vtable data, layout mismatches, and ambiguous ownership are retained as contradictions.
methodology.rtti_policy: SporeApp.exe has no MSVC RTTI; binary class identity is never promoted beyond SDK/header plus slot/layout agreement.
methodology.sorting: all arrays use explicit stable semantic or lexical keys; JSON object keys are sorted; no wall-clock values are emitted
